lines.en: - Hey. - Hey, check it out.
This is unbelievable.
Joey has been holding his breath for almost four minutes.
- What? - Dude, you trying to kill me?
- Thebes, I want to ask you something.
- Uh-huh, what? - Um, well, since I'm moving out
and--and you're so beautiful,
um, how would I move in with you?
- Well, that would be great,
but then what do we do about Denise?
- Who's Denise? - My roommate.
- Do you have a roommate? - Yes, Denise. Denise.
- Hey, what is with the secrecy, Phoebe? Huh?
And what about this Denise? Is she cute?
- Thebes, I understand. How can you have a roommate
that none of us know about?
- Maybe because you never listen to anything that I say.
I talk about her all the time. Denise!
- Hey, Grace, listen. I was thinking, uh,
I'm gonna have an extra room over at my place.
- Oh, that's true. - Yeah, why don't you move in with me?
- It'll be great. We can, like, stay up late talking
and watch movies and, you know,
about Naked Thursdays, right?
- Yeah, yeah, I think I'm gonna find my own place.
- Hey, hey!
I thought Naked Thursdays was just our thing, man.
